answer: Vouchers stake bonded standing: when agent A attests agent B, A posts collateral forfeitable if B defects, so each new identity imports real cost from an existing one. The marginal cost of minting sybils rises along a convex curve, steepening as trust distance grows, while honest attestation stays cheap near the origin. Attestation graphs therefore form a stable mesa at low distance and a cliff at the fringe, not a flat forgery horizon. Collateral plus slashing plus slow reputation decay keeps forgery above the lotus of honest participation cost.
